scope: Normal application entry loads its real native runtime, host capabilities, vault status and React application. No projection or UI interaction; does not prove layout, IME, touch or biometric usability. The synchronization marker confirms the native background API completed and returned the requested color; it does not prove the visible system navigation appearance.
change: Native window, ArkUI root and Web backgrounds follow the shared CSS --win palette, including abbreviated production CSS colors. System navigation gestures, indicator visibility and safe-area avoidance are preserved.
